title: Vetted Los Angeles Marketing Agencies for Every Growth Stage - inBeat Agency

facts.fact: The guide covers 22 Los Angeles marketing agencies.
facts.quote: This guide covers 22 Los Angeles marketing agencies, vetted for a real local office and at least one sourced case study

facts.fact: The guide was published on April 20, 2026.
The guide was last updated on September 21, 2026.
Each agency in the guide had to pass six checks before inclusion.
facts.quote: Every agency below passed six checks before inclusion:

facts.fact: One inclusion check requires at least one sourced case study tied to a business outcome.
facts.quote: at least one sourced case study tied to a business outcome.

facts.fact: The page states that its monthly ranges are industry-typical bands used where an agency does not publish its own minimum, and are not quotes from the specific agency.
facts.quote: Monthly ranges reflect industry-typical bands where an agency doesn't publish its own minimum, not a quote from that specific agency.

facts.fact: The page lists an industry-range monthly cost of $8,000–$50,000+ per month for Pivotal, a range the page attributes to industry norms rather than to Pivotal.
The page lists an industry-range monthly cost of $3,000–$10,000+ per month for inBeat Agency, a range the page attributes to industry norms rather than to inBeat.
The page lists inBeat Agency's headquarters as Montreal, with a verified Los Angeles office.
The page lists an industry-range monthly cost of $3,000–$10,000 per month for True North Social.
The page states that TBWA\Chiat\Day's engagement cost is an enterprise retainer that is not publicly disclosed.
As listed on the page, Boxfit's results with Pivotal were +50% profit, -30% costs, and +40% conversions.
As listed on the page, Hawke Media's Malibu Shirts result was +223% sales and +291% ROAS.
As listed on the page, Single Grain's Schumacher Homes result was cost per lead down from $125 to $72.
facts.quote: Schumacher Homes: CPL down from $125 to $72

facts.fact: As listed on the page, Social House's Rose LA result was ROAS rising from 1.7x to 2.2x and +$150K revenue.
